text.card: A red giant 2,857 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,981 K at its surface.
